diagnosis: Lymphangioma of the small intestine involving mucosa and submucosa
legend: The lymphatic channels are dilated and lined by inconspicuous endothelium, and they contain lymphatic fluid and occasional lipid-laden macrophages.

diagnosis: Lymphangioma of the small intestine predominantly involving muscularis propria
legend: Scattered thick-walled vessels with a smooth muscle wall, some with medial sclerosis, are also present.
